Syntactic Hilbert derivation of FS from CS5ModalAxiom (T+4+B+K+Kdia) hits a structural obstruction: DerivationTree.necessitation requires an empty-context sub-derivation, but every route to (A→B) from hypothesis (◇A→□B) genuinely needs that hypothesis in context, so it can never be lifted into □(A→B) via necessitation.
